# Cellular Agenomics Lab

How do cells decide their fate in an aging tissue? We integrate epigenetic, RNA, protein and metabolite data to read how each cell senses its environment, how it remembers past damage, and which environments push it toward aging.

[Our research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-light}
:::

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
## About the lab

Founded in 2020, the Cellular Agenomics Lab is a basic-science laboratory that seeks a deep understanding of why and how mammals age. We combine cell biology, genetics and bioinformatics to understand the cellular basis of aging.

[We are recruiting →](join.qmd)
:::
